turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
First, one example with my thinking.
"I found an egg." I say egg. It starts with the vowel sound "e". So I pick an.
Rule: an goes before a vowel sound, a before other sounds.
Right: We have a car. Wrong: We have an car.

Your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
